96821.description:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821.objectivesText: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
96821.title: Legging It

96822.description:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822.objectivesText: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
96822.title: For Honor

96825.description:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825.objectivesText: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
96825.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back

96873.description:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
96873.objectivesText: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
96873.title: A Pain in the Neck

96875.description:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, $c. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875.objectivesText: Kamari in Orgrimmar wants you to collect 5 Rough Lizard Hide from beasts in Thunder Ridge, along with 2 Cured Light Hides.
96875.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

96876.description: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
96876.objectivesText: Return the pack to Ukor in southern Durotar.
96876.title: Ukor's Lost Pack

97223.description:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223.objectivesText: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.
97223.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch

97225.description:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
97225.title: Forgotten Loa Idols

97236.description: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
97236.objectivesText: Deliver the Fang of Githyiss to someone interested in the study of spiders in Aldrassil.
97236.title: Fang of Githyiss

97246.description:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246.objectivesText: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
97246.title: Meal Appeal

97263.description: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
97263.title: Your Package Has Arrived

97277.description:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277.objectivesText: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.
97277.title: Grund and Gozwin

97279.description:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
97279.title: Wayward Weapons

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.

97485.description:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485.objectivesText:
Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.

Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.
97485.title: Traditions of the Bluff

97558.description:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $n. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558.objectivesText: Bring Shelene Rhobart $1oa Duskbat Wing Membranes, $2oa Darkhound Hides and $3oa Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
97558.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97899.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97899.objectivesText: Speak with Whuut in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97899.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

97900.description:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97900.objectivesText: Speak with Dwukk in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97900.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97901.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97901.objectivesText: Speak with Jhag in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97901.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97902.description:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97902.objectivesText: Speak with Mukdrak in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97902.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97903.description:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97903.objectivesText: Speak with Rawrk in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97903.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97904.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97904.objectivesText: Speak with Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97904.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97905.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905.objectivesText: Speak with Jandi in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97905.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97907.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907.objectivesText: Speak with Krunn in Razor Hill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97907.title: Camping 101: Mining

97908.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97908.objectivesText: Speak with Thuwd in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97908.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97921.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97922.description:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97922.objectivesText: Speak with Adele Fielder in Goldshire to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97922.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97924.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97925.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97925.objectivesText: Speak with Eldrin in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97925.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

objectives.text: Raise your first aid skill to 20

97942.objectivesText: Speak with Byancie in Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97942.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97944.description:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97944.objectivesText: Speak with Malorne Bladeleaf in Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97944.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

97949.description:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97949.objectivesText: Speak with Radnaal Maneweaver on the road to Darnassus from Dolanaar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97949.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97951.description:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97951.objectivesText: Speak with Carolai Anise in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97951.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97958.objectivesText: Speak with Shelene Rhobart on the road to Undercity from Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97958.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97959.description:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97959.objectivesText: Speak with Brom Killian in Undercity to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97959.title: Camping 101: Mining

Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.

So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97964.objectivesText: Speak with Aedi Thriceforged in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

97977.description:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Gnarlpine Totems and bring them to Tarindrella.
97977.title: Nature's Call

conditionalDescriptions.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and shall become a great priestess of our goddess Elune. Her grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.

97979.description:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979.title: The Goddess Provides

98067.description:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067.objectivesText: Place Sentinel Owls at the entrance to the Cenarion Hold depths, the Darnassus Bank, the Craftsman's Terrace Inn, and the City Gate for Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
98067.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98284.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98284.objectivesText: Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
98284.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Hoha! Good to see a fellow blacksmith who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.

98321.description:
Hoha! Good to see a $r who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Flintfire Shipments from the Grizzled Den for Tongus Flintfire in Kharanos.
98321.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98322.description:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322.objectivesText: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.
98322.title: Secure the Mountain

98326.description:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
98326.objectivesText: Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village.
98326.title: Frosthowl

conditionalDescriptions.text:
If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.

98389.description:
Greetings, $c. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
98389.objectivesText: Free $1oa Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
98389.title: A Light in the Darkness

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Blessings to you, $Gsister:fellow priest;. Our Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.

98391.description:
Blessings to you, $c. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391.objectivesText: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
98391.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98424.description:
Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
98424.objectivesText: Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
98424.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

98430.areaDescription: Escort Perith Stormhoof out of Palemane Rock
98430.description:
Hail, $c. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
98430.objectivesText: Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
98430.title: The Longwalkers

98512.description:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512.objectivesText: Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.
98512.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

98574.description: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98574.objectivesText: Read the Hallowed Memorandum and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.
98574.title: Hallowed Memorandum

98575.description: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $n.$B$BI usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
98575.objectivesText: Read the Tainted Tablet and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
98575.title: Tainted Tablet

98576.description: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
98576.objectivesText: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
98576.title: Glyphic Parchment

98581.description: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the shaman trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581.objectivesText: Read the Archaic Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
98581.title: Archaic Rune

98601.description:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601.objectivesText: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.
98601.title: A Difficult Path

99046.description:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
99046.objectivesText: Search for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road leading to the Oracle Glade.
99046.title: The Lost Runner

99047.description:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047.objectivesText: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolanaar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
99047.title: Not Dead Yet

99048.description:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048.objectivesText: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
99048.title: A Missing Hand

99049.description:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049.objectivesText: Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.
99049.title: Threat from Below

99051.description:
It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.

Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
99051.title: Threat from Below

99052.description:
One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.

It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
99052.objectivesText: Kill the sea giant along Durotar's north coast and bring back proof of your accomplishment.
99052.title: Threat from Below

99053.areaDescription: Escort Lynessa Duskblossom out of Ban'ethil
99053.description:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.

I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
99053.objectivesText: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.
99053.title: Escaping Ban'ethil

99079.description:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079.objectivesText: Find Longwalker Malah Longwind east of Bloodhoof Village, near the edge of Mulgore.
99079.title: Longwalker Malah

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Hail, young warrior. Our journey together shall take many strides, but this step is no less important than the others.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or mace. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Enter our space, and learn through combat. You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

99108.description:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.

objectives.text: Player Duels won or Novice Warriors defeated

99108.objectivesText: Defeat 3 other players in duels or Novice Warriors for Tang Stonehoof.
99108.title: Sparring Match

99123.areaDescription: Escort Pal'juh out of Kolkar Crag.
99123.description:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
99123.objectivesText: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
99123.title: Lost in the Shadows

99127.description:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127.objectivesText: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.
99127.title: A Net Disaster

99128.description:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Murlocs and $2oa Murloc Streamrunner at Crystal Lake, then return to Jason Mathers.
99128.title: Slimy Menace

99134.description:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--$n, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99134.title: Discipline

99141.description:
Make no mistake, $c--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141.objectivesText: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
99141.title: Patience

99142.description:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
99142.title: Tomb Weed

99143.description:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143.objectivesText: Collect $1oa pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.
99143.title: Bottles and Baubles

99144.areaDescription: Escort Bareth Dawnstone out of Crusader's Outpost

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all we stand for!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

Our ranks are thin. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.

99144.description:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144.objectivesText: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
99144.title: Seeking Refuge

99158.description:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158.objectivesText: Bring the crate of candles to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge.
99158.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159.description:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159.title: Finding Warmth

99160.description:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.
99160.title: Rime's Wrath

99162.description:
Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
99162.objectivesText: Collect the rifles of fallen mountaineers.
99162.title: Treacherous Cold

99411.description: Help, $n! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.$B$BWill you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.$B$BTo feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
99411.objectivesText: Ahab Wheathoof at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore wants you to feed his prized puppy, Kyle the Frenzied.$B$BFeed Kyle Tender Strider Meat and return to Ahab Wheathoof.
99411.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
